verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Rovo AI features focused on automations, trend identification, and connecting assets (jira-docs-4, jira-docs-15, jira-docs-18), but there is no evidence of a conversational Q&A interface that returns instant answers with citations from workspace content. Missing for 10: any documentation of a 'Rovo Chat' or Q&A assistant, citation/sourcing mechanism, or hands-on example of asking a question and receiving a cited answer.
